scope: Static read-only manifest, archive, source, official-docs, and primary-paper audit. No install, source compilation, CAMB execution, fit, score, or IDECAMB execution.

baseline.available_route: Official camb==2.0.4 precompiled PyPI wheel or complete pinned source build

target_ivs_model.paper_sign: Gamma>0 transfers energy from CDM to vacuum in forward time
target_ivs_model.paper_perturbation_closure: IVS vacuum has no perturbative contribution; implement delta_rho_v=0

camb_source_assessment.dark_energy_interface: A model marked cosmological_constant gets constant grhov*a^2; non-constant models can provide dynamic density/w through the background interface. Base stress-energy perturbation callback returns zero density perturbation and heat flux; default perturbation-equation count is zero.
camb_source_assessment.fluid_w_minus_one: DarkEnergyFluid identifies w=-1, wa=0 as cosmological constant; changing its parameters alone cannot produce interacting-vacuum evolution.
uncoupled_cdm_assumptions: results.f90 background species output contains grhoc*a
equations.f90 native synchronous CDM density equation is clxcdot=-k*z
minimum_changes: Implement and store a coupled rho_c(a), rho_v(a) history consistent with Friedmann closure and both continuity equations.
Route all background expansion, perturbation-source density weights, background density outputs, and residual rho_c proportional to a^-3 consumers through the coupled rho_c(a).
Add the conformal-time CDM density source +a*Gamma*(rho_v/rho_c)*delta_c in CAMB units; retain geodesic/CDM-comoving velocity behavior and verify its initialization.
Represent the evolving vacuum as non-cosmological-constant in the background dispatcher while explicitly returning zero vacuum perturbative stress-energy and no vacuum perturbation variables.
Demonstrate Gamma=0 recovery of the pinned stock CAMB LCDM baseline and validate early-time regular-mode/stability behavior before any CMB inference.

next_command_recommendation: For stock LambdaCDM only, use an isolated environment with official camb==2.0.4 wheel and record environment/hash. For edited source, perform a recursive checkout at a6de8cc59124c8bbe3924f1c546f96cef73dcabb, record HEAD and submodule status, provision a supported Fortran compiler, then implement and test the coupled background/perturbation hooks.
limitations: No CAMB baseline was executed; only a feasible stock-wheel/source route is identified.
No modified CAMB source, test, likelihood, or inference was run.
The local source archive omits forutils contents and does not record its gitlink SHA in the manifest; exact dependency pin remains to be recovered from a recursive checkout.
A separate source-paper audit found no explicit author perturbation initial-condition prescription; a future independent CMB solver must declare and test it.
This does not reproduce the authors' modified CAMB, Cobaya configuration, likelihood, or chain results.
